info.name: Workflow Tracker API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Workflow Tracker backend.

All endpoints (except the auth endpoints) require a valid JWT Bearer token. Run **Authentication → Get Token** first — the test script automatically stores it as `accessToken`.

Base URL is stored in the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: http://localhost:8000/api).

The happy-path folder runs all transitions in order — login as applicant → create → submit → login as reviewer → start-review → decision.
Use the included environment file to persist the `appId`, `accessToken`, and `refreshToken` variables across requests.

variable.description: Primary key of the application under test. Update after creating an application.
JWT access token. Set automatically by the 'Get Token' request test script.
JWT refresh token. Set automatically by the 'Get Token' request test script.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: JWT authentication endpoints. Run 'Get Token' first to obtain an access token — the test script saves it as `accessToken` for use by all other requests.

request.description: Create a new user account. `role` must be `"applicant"` or `"reviewer"`. Role cannot be changed after registration.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Bad Request — username taken

request.description:
Obtain a JWT access + refresh token pair. The test script automatically saves both tokens as collection variables.

Change the body to `{{reviewerUsername}}` / `{{reviewerPassword}}` to log in as the reviewer.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized — bad credentials

request.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token. Use when the access token has expired (8-hour lifetime).

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized — invalid or expired refresh token

request.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile. Inherits the collection-level Bearer auth — no extra setup needed once `accessToken` is set.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Workflow Actions
item.description:
Status transition endpoints. Each moves the application through the workflow state machine.

Expected order: submit → start-review → decision.
If decision is `Need More Information`, the applicant calls resubmit, then the cycle restarts from start-review.

request.description:
Transition: **Draft → Submitted**

Sets `submitted_at` to the current UTC time. Fails with `400` if the application is not in `Draft` status.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:
{
  "id": 1,
  "owner_id": 3,
  "tracking_number": "APP-20260520-A3F9C",
  "applicant_name": "Jane Doe",
  "applicant_email": "jane@example.com",
  "company_name": "Acme Ltd",
  "application_type": "Renewal",
  "description": "Annual licence renewal for permit #1234.",
  "status": "Submitted",
  "reviewer_comment": null,
  "created_at": "2026-05-20T09:00:00Z",

item.name: Happy Path — Full Workflow
item.description:
Run these requests in order to walk a single application through the complete approval workflow:

0. Login as Applicant (saves accessToken)  
1. Create Application (saves appId)  
2. Submit  
3. Login as Reviewer (updates accessToken)  
4. Start Review  
5. Decision (Approved)

Each login step updates the `accessToken` collection variable for the correct role.

request.description: Obtain a token as the applicant role. The test script saves it as `accessToken`.

body.raw:
{
  "applicant_name": "Happy Path User",
  "applicant_email": "happy@example.com",
  "company_name": "Happy Path Corp",
  "application_type": "Renewal",
  "description": "Happy path end-to-end test application."
}

request.description: Creates the application and automatically sets `appId` via the test script.
Draft → Submitted
Switch to reviewer token before calling start-review and decision endpoints.
Submitted → Under Review
Under Review → Approved (terminal state)

item.name: Need More Info — Re-review Workflow
item.description:
Demonstrates the 'Need More Information' branch:

0. Login as Applicant  
1. Create Application (saves appId)  
2. Submit  
3. Login as Reviewer  
4. Start Review  
5. Decision (Need More Information)  
6. Login as Applicant  
7. Update Application (add missing info)  
8. Resubmit  
9. Login as Reviewer  
10. Start Review (again)  
11. Decision (Approved)

request.description: Obtain a token as the applicant role.

body.raw:
{
  "applicant_name": "Re-review User",
  "applicant_email": "rereview@example.com",
  "company_name": "Re-review Corp",
  "application_type": "Change of Name",
  "description": "Requesting a change of registered name."
}
